mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.biz_type, v.biz_id, v.biz_no, v.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, v.qty, v.remark, v.create_time FROM inv_movement v LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = v.warehouse_id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND v.material_id = #{materialId} AND v.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND v.qty > 0 ORDER BY v.id ASC
